intended_object: The property (as an ObjectProperty on the category of R-modules) of an R-module being finitely generated and projective. This comes from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body is the conjunction `Module.Finite R P ∧ Module.Projective R P`. In Mathlib, `Module.Finite` means finitely generated and `Module.Projective` is the standard notion of a projective module. The definition works over an arbitrary (not necessarily commutative) ring R and in any universe, which is the natural generality for finitely generated projective modules. Mathlib has the analogous `ModuleCat.isFG` (the finitely generated modules), but nothing that combines finite generation with projectivity as an ObjectProperty, so there is no counterpart to cite.
